lebron.headline: 2026-2027 priority: perimeter defense
lebron.note: Season projection flags perimeter defense as the area to reverse a projected dip in — training below is weighted toward it.

exercises.name: Passing-lane anticipation
exercises.note: Read the ball-handler’s eyes and hips to jump the lane. The eyes give away the pass a half-second before the hands do — train the read, not just the reaction.

exercises.name: Closeout-to-strip drills
exercises.note: Controlled closeouts that end in a strip, not a foul. Attack the ball with the back hand while staying in a legal, balanced stance, so the steal doesn’t turn into a cheap foul.

curry.headline: 2026-2027 priority: rebounding
curry.note: Season projection flags rebounding as the area to reverse a projected dip in — training below is weighted toward it.

exercises.name: Box-out & pursuit drills
exercises.note: Contact, seal, and go get the ball off the rim. Find the body of the opponent before the shot even goes up — rebounding position is won before the ball arrives, not after.

exercises.name: Anticipation rebounding
exercises.note: React off missed-shot angles, not just position. Study where long and short misses tend to bounce from each shot location so the pursuit becomes instinctive rather than reactive.

giannis.headline: 2026-2027 priority: scoring
giannis.note: Season projection flags scoring as the area to reverse a projected dip in — training below is weighted toward it.

exercises.name: Game-speed scoring reps
exercises.note: Combine footwork, one dribble and a finish at full pace. Slow, controlled reps don’t transfer to games — every rep here should be run at the tempo an actual possession demands.

exercises.name: Shot-selection film + reps
exercises.note: Rehearse the shots the season plan calls for most. Watch the clip, then immediately walk onto the floor and shoot that exact shot — pairing film with reps locks in the habit far faster than either alone.

exercises.name: Live-read passing series
exercises.note: Advantage creation into a live decision, not a script. A defender reacts live rather than following a set pattern, so every pass has to answer what the defense is actually doing.

exercises.name: Pick-and-roll manipulation
exercises.note: Change speeds and angles to open a passing window. A hard, then slow, then hard again attack rhythm is what actually breaks pick-and-roll coverages down over a season.

bane.headline: 2026-2027 priority: perimeter defense
bane.note: Season projection flags perimeter defense as the area to keep pushing a modest gain in — training below is weighted toward it.

exercises.name: Passing-lane anticipation
exercises.note: Read the ball-handler’s eyes and hips to jump the lane. The eyes give away the pass a half-second before the hands do — train the read, not just the reaction.

exercises.name: Closeout-to-strip drills
exercises.note: Controlled closeouts that end in a strip, not a foul. Attack the ball with the back hand while staying in a legal, balanced stance, so the steal doesn’t turn into a cheap foul.

mikal.headline: 2026-2027 priority: rebounding
mikal.note: Season projection flags rebounding as the area to keep pushing a modest gain in — training below is weighted toward it.

exercises.name: Box-out & pursuit drills
exercises.note: Contact, seal, and go get the ball off the rim. Find the body of the opponent before the shot even goes up — rebounding position is won before the ball arrives, not after.

exercises.name: Anticipation rebounding
exercises.note: React off missed-shot angles, not just position. Study where long and short misses tend to bounce from each shot location so the pursuit becomes instinctive rather than reactive.

exercises.note: Change speeds and angles to open a passing window. A hard, then slow, then hard again attack rhythm is what actually breaks pick-and-roll coverages down over a season.

dalton-knecht.headline: 2026-2027 priority: perimeter defense
dalton-knecht.note: Season projection flags perimeter defense as the area to keep pushing a modest gain in — training below is weighted toward it.

exercises.name: Passing-lane anticipation
exercises.note: Read the ball-handler’s eyes and hips to jump the lane. The eyes give away the pass a half-second before the hands do — train the read, not just the reaction.

exercises.name: Closeout-to-strip drills
exercises.note: Controlled closeouts that end in a strip, not a foul. Attack the ball with the back hand while staying in a legal, balanced stance, so the steal doesn’t turn into a cheap foul.
